newsitem.title: USA: ArQule enters collaboration with FibroGen.
newsitem.headline: ArQule enters collaboration with FibroGen.

text.p: ArQule Inc said on Tuesday that it is collaborating with FibroGen Inc to develop drug candidates for the treatment of fibrotic disorders and post-surgical scarring.
Terms of the collaboration were not disclosed. FibroGen is privately owned.

"By combining FibroGen's proprietary technology and its proven methods of blocking fibrosis with ArQule's ability to rapidly generate and optimize valuable chemical lead compounds, we can facilitate the generation, optimization, and development of drug candidates to treat fibrosis and excessive scarring," FibroGen president and chief executive officer Thomas Neff said in a press release.
